notes.title: Kernmantle - Developer Livestream
notes.notes: Welcome to the Kernmantle Steam Game Festival livestream. Feel free to ask any questions about this physics-based climbing game, coming late 2020.

notes.title: Kernmantle - A 2000-meter vertical climbing game.
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=V88PvNE1Ta8;full][/previewyoutube]

Kernmantle is an upcoming game about scaling a huge 2000-meter canyon. A shiny new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1261820/Kernmantle/]Steam page[/url] has just been published, and we're (hopefully) looking forward to inclusion in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival]Steam Game Festival[/url].

For more updates you can follow on [url=https://twitter.com/NorthOfEarth]Twitter[/url].

Add Kernmantle to your wishlist now!

Seriously, do it.

Please.
